title: Established meteor showers
owner: IAU Meteor Data Center (IAU Commission F1, Meteors, Meteorites and Interplanetary Dust)
document_title: IAU Meteor Data Center — Established meteor showers, V.2
authority: The IAU Meteor Data Center names and numbers meteor showers. A shower's IAU number, three-letter code, name, radiant and geocentric velocity are the MDC's facts, served here and credited to it.
terms: The MDC database is maintained on an unpaid voluntary basis and asks to be cited. Its requested references are carried in `citations` below and are returned by meteor_source_info, printed in the README and recorded in NOTICE. This package does not redistribute the MDC's file: it records the file's URL and SHA-256 and holds the facts read from it.
